subcategory: 1.5-km Seaside Promenade in the French Quarter (White Town)
description: The scenic 1.5-kilometer beachfront promenade along the Bay of Bengal in the heritage French Quarter (White Town), flanked by black volcanic rocks, the 4-meter Mahatma Gandhi Statue, French War Memorial, and 19th-century Old Lighthouse.
why_visit: Stroll down the completely pedestrianized seaside promenade (closed to motorized vehicles every evening), admire colonial French architecture, and eat croissants and gelatos at beachfront French cafes.
best_time_to_visit: October to March (Promenade vehicle-free 6:00 PM - 7:30 AM daily)
activities: Seaside Promenade Walking; French Cafe Hopping; French Quarter Cycling; Gandhi Statue Photography
notes: Swimming prohibited due to rocky tetrapods; ideal for peaceful evening strolls.

subcategory: Golden Sphere of Human Unity & Inner Meditation Chamber
description: Founded in 1968 by Mirra Alfassa (The Mother) as an experimental universal township dedicated to human unity, centered around the breathtaking golden geodesic dome of Matrimandir, housing the world's largest optically pure glass crystal globe (70 cm diameter).
why_visit: Behold the magnificent golden spherical dome covered in golden discs, meditate in complete silence in the pure white marble Inner Chamber illuminated by a single sunbeam piercing the crystal globe, and tour the tranquil gardens.
best_time_to_visit: October to March (Visitors Centre 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM)
activities: Matrimandir Viewing Point Walk; Inner Chamber Silent Meditation; Auroville Organic Cafe Dining; Boutique Handicrafts Shopping
notes: Inner Chamber meditation requires mandatory advance booking in person at the Visitors Centre or online.
